summary: Frontend visual/content audit completed for EGMG site. Verified across 9 pages: HomePage, BusinessesPage, AboutPage, GoldcarPage, RoyalLimousinePage, EmiratesTaxiPage, TrucklinePage, UsedCarsPage, ServicesPage. All hero images now load from UAE-specific sources (Dubai unsplash/pexels), all booking CTAs route internally to /book-chauffeur (verified Hero, Bottom CTA, Nav BOOK NOW, Royal Limo, Emirates Taxi, Services Chauffeur), all egmg.ae logos render correctly including Emirates Taxi product logo (Adobe-Express-file.webp). Truckline 'Trusted by Leading Businesses' section renders all 10 client logos from egmg.ae successfully (l-2 through l-11). Mobile responsiveness verified for Emirates Taxi and Truckline pages.

issues: Emirates Taxi logo image is square (770x790) but constrained to h-12 w-auto with brightness-0 invert opacity-80 making it appear as a tiny ~48x48 faint white square in hero - barely visible; consider fixed width or remove brightness-0 to preserve original logo design

action_items: (Optional) Improve Emirates Taxi hero logo presentation - currently rendered as ~48x48 inverted white square due to constraints; consider fixed wider width or remove brightness-0 invert filter so the actual logo design is visible
critical_code_review_comments: Truckline client logos array is hardcoded inline within JSX - consider extracting to a top-level const for readability/maintainability
Multiple pages duplicate DIVISION_LOGOS object (HomePage.js, AboutPage.js) - extract to a shared constants module to follow DRY
Several pages use lazy loading on hero/above-the-fold logo images which can cause slight visual delay on first paint - consider eager loading for hero-area images
